data.summary: Financial Analyst with hands-on experience in trade and transaction reporting, reconciliation, and exception management for a global investment bank (Morgan Stanley, via eClerx), plus an earlier stint in taxation and statutory audit during a CA articleship. Comfortable across the full trade lifecycle for OTC and exchange-traded derivatives – Interest Rates, Credit, FX, Equity, Equity Swaps and Commodities – and well versed in the reporting obligations under EMIR, CFTC, SEC, CSA, ESMA and FCA. Regularly investigate breaks (C2D/A2D), get to the root cause instead of just patching the symptom, and work directly with Operations, Risk, Technology and Change teams to fix control gaps. Comfortable pulling and validating data through SQL and Python rather than relying only on manual checks. Recognised twice with eClerx’s “My Thanks” award for accuracy and client-first delivery, and currently the only analyst on the team independently owning two NA controls.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Financial Analyst — Regulatory Reporting | eClerx (supporting Morgan Stanley) • Own trade and transaction reporting for OTC and exchange-traded derivatives across Interest Rates, Credit, FX, Equity, Equity Swaps and Commodities, making sure submissions under EMIR, CFTC, SEC, CSA, ESMA and FCA go out accurately and on time.
2024 – Present
Reconcile trades between internal trade systems, GTRS and DTCC on a daily basis, and dig into C2D and A2D breaks to find the actual root cause rather than just clearing the exception – which has cut down repeat breaks on a couple of recurring issues.
Flag misreporting, under-reporting and over-reporting to Compliance and Operations before they turn into regulatory issues, and keep a paper trail (SOPs, run books, error logs) so the reasoning is auditable later.
Work daily in Trend, Poseidon, CreditOne, Hammer and Leo Cash to pull trade data, cross-check it against golden source/reference data, and clean up discrepancies before they hit the report.
Put together the daily, weekly and monthly regulatory and MIS reports – this involves chasing data owners as much as it does the actual number-crunching, especially around month-end.
Get pulled into UAT whenever there’s a change to the reporting logic – writing test cases against the business requirement and signing off before it goes live.
Built a couple of SQL/Python scripts to automate parts of the daily reconciliation that used to be done manually in Excel, which freed up time for actual break investigation.
Currently the only analyst on the team handling two NA controls independently – picked this up within the first year, which isn’t typical for someone this new to the process.
Executive, Customer Operations | Capita India Pvt Ltd • Handled a high volume of customer queries daily over live chat and email, resolving most on first contact and keeping
2022 – 2024
response times within SLA.
Logged every interaction in the CRM with enough detail that the next person picking up the case didn’t have to ask the customer to repeat themselves; escalated the trickier ones to the right team instead of sitting on them.
Kept customer satisfaction scores consistently high through clear, professional written communication – got called out for this by name a few times.
Won Employee of the Month for consistent performance.
Associate, Content Review | Accenture Solutions Pvt Ltd • Reviewed user-generated content against community guidelines and applicable legal standards, making judgment calls
2021 – 2022
on borderline cases rather than just applying a checklist.
Flagged and removed illegal or policy-violating content, and escalated sensitive or ambiguous cases to seniors with the right context so they could decide quickly.
Article Assistant (CA Articleship) | B. D. Jokhakar & Co • Assisted with statutory and tax audits for client companies – vouching transactions, checking supporting documentation,
2019-2021
and flagging discrepancies to the audit senior.
Supported preparation and filing of income tax returns, TDS returns, and GST returns for individual and corporate clients.
Helped compile financial statements and audit working papers, and cross-checked figures against ledgers and bank statements for accuracy.
Got early exposure to compliance timelines and client documentation requirements – groundwork that carried over directly into the regulatory reporting work that followed.
